scope: Read-only selection now; collect only after the fixed plan is reviewed.

selection_rule.parent_and_successor_groups: both train in the pinned split plan
selection_rule.parent_availability: both saved parent attempts must already have a valid successful full-scene assessment and an idle registered post-assessment state; no successor outcome is available or used
selection_rule.candidate_relation: all legal successor transfers except the direct reversal of the parent and any previously collected parent-successor combination
selection_rule.successor_direction: each of the twelve ordered directions 1..4 exactly once
selection_rule.tie_break: iterate successor directions lexicographically; within each direction iterate parent case ID, successor case ID and moved ID lexicographically; use the first complete assignment satisfying all quotas with distinct parents

teacher.grasp_diagnostic: For each command endpoint, keep privileged object and TCP position and positive left/right pad contact. A lack-of-contact-and-distance loss guard is not evidence that a grasp succeeded; only the separate full-scene stability assessment determines positive episodes.

state_handoff: construct the compatible original simulator model, restore the entire saved parent post-assessment state and prove exact saved-state equality before the successor; no reset or homing between restored state and teacher command
failure_policy: Record all 24 planned parent-seed entries; keep restore errors, unknowns, teacher failures and post-assessment failures. Never substitute another seed, task, clipping, or retry. Save positive episodes only for full-scene successes.
student_inputs: existing 82 features and up to eight observations; object poses, contacts, teacher phases and targets remain privileged

later_student_comparison.model_and_baseline: existing 82-input MLP and its uniform 1,000-update baseline
later_student_comparison.planned_batch_composition: reuse the original 192 base examples and 32 of the original 64 continuation examples in their original order; replace the other 32 with new teacher examples
later_student_comparison.unchanged: starting weights, model, loss, optimizer settings, updates, batch size and total exposure
later_student_comparison.sampling_schedule: to be fixed only after collection outcome and available teacher records are known
later_student_comparison.baseline_physical_reuse: reuse the existing 18 baseline cases only when checkpoint, evaluator, entire start state and execution contract match
